faqs.question: What is My Funded Futures?
faqs.answer: My Funded Futures (MFFU) is a US futures proprietary trading firm founded in 2023 and operated by MyFunded Futures, LLC. Traders buy a one-time evaluation (Rapid, Rapid EOD, Flex, Pro or Builder), pass a profit target without hitting the max loss, then trade a simulated funded account from $25,000 to $150,000. The firm pays a share of simulated profits in real cash via Riseworks; live capital is invitation-only after meeting extra performance criteria.

seo.title: What is My Funded Futures? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: My Funded Futures is a 2023 US futures prop firm offering Rapid, Pro, Flex and Builder plans from $25K to $150K with up to a 90/10 split.

faqs.question: What is the My Funded Futures profit split?
faqs.answer: Splits are flat by plan, not a 'first $10K at 100%' ladder. Rapid and Rapid EOD pay 90% to the trader / 10% to MFFU. Pro, Flex and Builder sim-funded accounts pay 80/20. There is no add-on to raise the split further; pick the plan that matches the split you want before buying.

seo.title: My Funded Futures Profit Split: 90% Rapid, 80% Pro | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: MFFU Rapid plans pay a flat 90/10 split; Pro, Flex and Builder sim accounts pay 80/20. There is no 100% first-tranche tier.

faqs.question: How often can I request a payout from My Funded Futures?
faqs.answer: On Rapid and Rapid EOD you can request a payout every 24 hours once the required profit buffer is in the account and you have net profit since the last payout. Flex requires 5 winning days. Pro pays every 14 calendar days from the first funded trade, with a $1,000 minimum. Builder uses a capped cycle (typically 5 sim payouts) before a live-account review. Most approvals are instant; a manual review can take 6–12 business hours on weekdays.

seo.title: My Funded Futures Payout Cycle by Plan | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Rapid pays daily after a 24-hour window, Flex after 5 winning days, and Pro every 14 calendar days, all via Riseworks.

faqs.question: Which withdrawal methods does My Funded Futures support, and are there fees?
faqs.answer: Every payout is sent to Riseworks after KYC. From Rise you withdraw by US ACH / bank transfer or cryptocurrency. MFFU does not add its own payout fee. Minimums depend on the plan: $500 on Rapid, $250 on Flex, and $1,000 on Pro. First-time payees must sign Riseworks contractor agreements before funds can leave Rise.

seo.title: My Funded Futures Withdrawal Methods and Fees | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: MFFU pays through Riseworks via ACH or crypto. Rapid's minimum is $500; Flex is $250 and Pro is $1,000.

faqs.question: How do My Funded Futures drawdown and payout buffers work?
faqs.answer: Rapid EOD uses an end-of-day max loss in both evaluation and funded (for example $1,000 on 25K and $2,000 on 50K) with no daily loss limit. The payout buffer is the max-loss floor plus $100, so a 50K Rapid EOD account typically needs $2,100 of open profit left in the account. After the first approved payout the maximum loss limit usually locks to a static $100. Hitting the max loss at any stage closes the account.

seo.title: My Funded Futures Drawdown and Payout Buffer | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Rapid EOD uses EOD trailing max loss with no daily loss limit. Keep the buffer (max loss + $100) in the account to stay payout-eligible.
